criticalChecks.rule: Both original unknown request IDs must remain unknown. No invented terminal outcome or billing conclusion; a later different-ID success settles only that later request.
Do not present changing requestId merely to retry as permitted recovery. Reporting historical workaround is not permission.
Do not attribute implementation choices to explicit user approval.
Do not claim the earlier orientation problem still needs repair or that later success evidence is absent.
Recognize that scene edits after latest current-check revision require refreshing/rechecking; do not assert prior success is current validation.
Preserve exact tool paths and unfinished React/build/runtime checkpoint. Historical bridge paths are not proof of current availability.

evaluation: Inspect both generated summary and final handoff. Report phases separately; a correct handoff does not erase an unsupported summary. Missing or contradicted critical evidence is not a pass.
cost: Record uncached input, cache reads/creation and output separately for summary and handoff. No monetary savings claim without billing rates. Total unweighted tokens are not currency costs.
decision: Only correctness-passing arms can win on cost. If both fail, accept neither and stop after this round.
